items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the Bescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by post. Per the letter's own rule and § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a letter sent by post is deemed bekannt gegeben (delivered/notified) on the 4th day after it was sent: 20.11. + 4 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday) — not a weekend/holiday in NRW, so no shift is needed. The one-month Widerspruch period then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of notification (24.11.2026) is excluded from the count (§187 Abs.1), and the period ends on the day of the following month that bears the same calendar number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and is not a statutory public holiday in NRW (only 25./26.12. are holidays), so no further shift applies. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
